name: drvs
description: Dynamic Revealing Vector Search — a corpus-agnostic, mostly-client-side search engine: exact/lexical/dictionary/relation/semantic channels fused with an honest tiered-confidence UI contract, plus a Python build-time pipeline for chunking and embedding any document corpus.
author: Neo.K / EveMissLab
